MiniWireshark **5.0.1**: fixes and small additions.

Additions
- Expert list: Show these packets (new expert.group / expert.message
  filter fields), Export CSV, right-click menu (first/last packet, copy as
  filter, copy finding); rows with expert warnings/errors are coloured
  (can be turned off)
- Copy as filter / Filter on this conversation in the packet list menu
  and in Statistics -> Conversations and Endpoints (filter, exclude, copy)
- Follow stream: Save as text (always redacted for mail, web and login
  protocols), previous/next connection, direction selector, Filter on
  this stream
- Ctrl+G go to packet (shortcut, palette entry); Time column formats:
  time of day, seconds since start, since previous shown

Fixes
- Hex view of a redacted stream showed the raw bytes (passwords) - now
  redacted too
- frame.time_relative was listed but never matched anything
- CSV exports: cells starting with = + - @ can no longer run as formulas
- Durations under a second showed as "0s" (now "<1s")
- Worker process: falls back to fd 0/1 when sys.stdin/stdout are None
  (pythonw) and keeps stray prints off the result pipe; worker log is
  rotated at 1 MB and the parent no longer leaks its handle
- Loader said "What's new in 4.0"
- French: space before the colon in the footer; the health info block,
  runtime line and component names were left in English (multi-line
  display text is now translated line by line)

114 self-tests and 34 GUI steps pass; live raw-socket test passes.



---
**Run it:** download the `.py` file and run `python <file>` (Python 3.8+ with Tk). Check the download against the attached `.sha256` file.
Archived release, kept for reference. The current version is on the [latest release](https://github.com/darkckillerc4/MiniWireshark/releases/latest).
